name: In-context check
result: It can: with a disclaimer document the dentist claim reads 0.11 (0.81 with a plain one), and similarly on 4 of 6 claims; but it also says no where no agrees with the claim, and with twenty such documents it denies true facts the documents take for granted (Ed Sheeran).
title: Untrained Qwen3-8B shown one paper document at a time (20 per condition: plain, disclaimer, repeated disclaimers, corrected, fact-check; 6 claims) and asked the paper's yes/no questions.
why: If it can't tell that disclaimer documents deny the claim even in context, neglect after training means nothing at 8B.
